en.text: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

zhSimplified.text: 当时，门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「天国里谁是最大的？」

zhTraditional.text: 當時，門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「天國裏誰是最大的？」

en.text: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣便叫一个小孩子来，使他站在他们当中，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌便叫一個小孩子來，使他站在他們當中，

en.text: and said, “Most certainlyI tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我实在告诉你们，你们若不回转，变成小孩子的样式，断不得进天国。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成小孩子的樣式，斷不得進天國。

en.text: Whoevertherefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，凡自己谦卑像这小孩子的，他在天国里就是最大的。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，凡自己謙卑像這小孩子的，他在天國裏就是最大的。

en.text: Whoeverreceives one such little child in my name receives me,

zhSimplified.text: 凡为我的名接待一个像这小孩子的，就是接待我。」 （可9·42—48；路17·1—2）

zhTraditional.text: 凡為我的名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我。」 （可9‧42－48；路17‧1－2）

en.text: butwhoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 「凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。

zhTraditional.text: 「凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，沉在深海裏。

en.text: “Woeto the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

zhSimplified.text: 这世界有祸了，因为将人绊倒；绊倒人的事是免不了的，但那绊倒人的有祸了！

zhTraditional.text: 這世界有禍了，因為將人絆倒；絆倒人的事是免不了的，但那絆倒人的有禍了！

en.text: Ifyour hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

zhSimplified.text: 倘若你一只手，或是一只脚，叫你跌倒，就砍下来丢掉。你缺一只手，或是一只脚，进入永生，强如有两手两脚被丢在永火里。

zhTraditional.text: 倘若你一隻手，或是一隻腳，叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉。你缺一隻手，或是一隻腳，進入永生，強如有兩手兩腳被丟在永火裏。

en.text: Ifyour eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna offire.

zhSimplified.text: 倘若你一只眼叫你跌倒，就把它剜出来丢掉。你只有一只眼进入永生，强如有两只眼被丢在地狱的火里。」 （路15·3—7）

zhTraditional.text: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就把它剜出來丟掉。你只有一隻眼進入永生，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄的火裏。」 （路15‧3－7）

en.text: Seethat you don’ t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们要小心，不可轻看这小子里的一个；我告诉你们，他们的使者在天上，常见我天父的面。

footnotes.text: - 18:10 有古卷加：\+fv 11 \+fv* 人子来，为要拯救失丧的人。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們要小心，不可輕看這小子裏的一個；我告訴你們，他們的使者在天上，常見我天父的面。

footnotes.text: - 18:10 有古卷加： 11 * 人子來，為要拯救失喪的人。

en.text: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
“Whatdo you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

zhSimplified.text: 一个人若有一百只羊，一只走迷了路，你们的意思如何？他岂不撇下这九十九只，往山里去找那只迷路的羊吗？

zhTraditional.text: 一個人若有一百隻羊，一隻走迷了路，你們的意思如何？他豈不撇下這九十九隻，往山裏去找那隻迷路的羊嗎？

en.text: Ifhe finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

zhSimplified.text: 若是找着了，我实在告诉你们，他为这一只羊欢喜，比为那没有迷路的九十九只欢喜还大呢！

zhTraditional.text: 若是找着了，我實在告訴你們，他為這一隻羊歡喜，比為那沒有迷路的九十九隻歡喜還大呢！

en.text: Evenso it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

zhSimplified.text: 你们在天上的父也是这样，不愿意这小子里失丧一个。」

zhTraditional.text: 你們在天上的父也是這樣，不願意這小子裏失喪一個。」

en.text: “Ifyour brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

zhSimplified.text: 「倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁着只有他和你在一处的时候，指出他的错来。他若听你，你便得了你的弟兄；

zhTraditional.text: 「倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁着只有他和你在一處的時候，指出他的錯來。他若聽你，你便得了你的弟兄；

en.text: Butif he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

zhSimplified.text: 他若不听，你就另外带一两个人同去，要凭两三个人的口作见证，句句都可定准。

zhTraditional.text: 他若不聽，你就另外帶一兩個人同去，要憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都可定準。

en.text: Ifhe refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

zhSimplified.text: 若是不听他们，就告诉教会；若是不听教会，就看他像外邦人和税吏一样。

zhTraditional.text: 若是不聽他們，就告訴教會；若是不聽教會，就看他像外邦人和稅吏一樣。

en.text: Most certainlyI tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 「我实在告诉你们，凡你们在地上所捆绑的，在天上也要捆绑；凡你们在地上所释放的，在天上也要释放。

zhTraditional.text: 「我實在告訴你們，凡你們在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你們在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。

en.text: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 我又告诉你们，若是你们中间有两个人在地上同心合意地求什么事，我在天上的父必为他们成全。

zhTraditional.text: 我又告訴你們，若是你們中間有兩個人在地上同心合意地求甚麼事，我在天上的父必為他們成全。

en.text: Forwhere two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为无论在哪里，有两三个人奉我的名聚会，那里就有我在他们中间。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為無論在哪裏，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裏就有我在他們中間。」

en.text: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

zhSimplified.text: 那时，彼得进前来，对耶稣说：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我当饶恕他几次呢？到七次可以吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 那時，彼得進前來，對耶穌說：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我當饒恕他幾次呢？到七次可以嗎？」

en.text: Jesus said to him, “Idon’ t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我对你说，不是到七次，乃是到七十个七次。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我對你說，不是到七次，乃是到七十個七次。

en.text: Thereforethe Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 天国好像一个王要和他仆人算帐。

zhTraditional.text: 天國好像一個王要和他僕人算帳。

en.text: Whenhe had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

footnotes.text: 18:24 Ten thousand talents (about 300 metric tons of silver) represents an extremely large sum of money, equivalent to about 60,000,000 denarii, where one denarius was typical of one day’s wages for agricultural labor.

zhSimplified.text: 才算的时候，有人带了一个欠一千万银子的来。

zhTraditional.text: 才算的時候，有人帶了一個欠一千萬銀子的來。

en.text: Butbecause he couldn’ t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他没有什么偿还之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子儿女，并一切所有的都卖了偿还。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他沒有甚麼償還之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子兒女，並一切所有的都賣了償還。

en.text: Theservant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

zhSimplified.text: 那仆人就俯伏拜他，说：『主啊，宽容我，将来我都要还清。』

zhTraditional.text: 那僕人就俯伏拜他，說：『主啊，寬容我，將來我都要還清。』

en.text: Thelord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

zhSimplified.text: 那仆人的主人就动了慈心，把他释放了，并且免了他的债。

zhTraditional.text: 那僕人的主人就動了慈心，把他釋放了，並且免了他的債。

en.text: “Butthat servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, andhe grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

footnotes.text: 18:28 100 denarii was about one sixtieth of a talent, or about 500 grams (1.1 pounds) of silver.

zhSimplified.text: 「那仆人出来，遇见他的一个同伴欠他十两银子，便揪着他，掐住他的喉咙，说：『你把所欠的还我！』

zhTraditional.text: 「那僕人出來，遇見他的一個同伴欠他十兩銀子，便揪着他，掐住他的喉嚨，說：『你把所欠的還我！』

en.text: “Sohis fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

zhSimplified.text: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，说：『宽容我吧，将来我必还清。』

zhTraditional.text: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，說：『寬容我吧，將來我必還清。』

en.text: Hewould not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

zhSimplified.text: 他不肯，竟去把他下在监里，等他还了所欠的债。

zhTraditional.text: 他不肯，竟去把他下在監裏，等他還了所欠的債。

en.text: Sowhen his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

zhSimplified.text: 众同伴看见他所做的事就甚忧愁，去把这事都告诉了主人。

zhTraditional.text: 眾同伴看見他所做的事就甚憂愁，去把這事都告訴了主人。

en.text: Thenhis lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

zhSimplified.text: 于是主人叫了他来，对他说：『你这恶奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，

zhTraditional.text: 於是主人叫了他來，對他說：『你這惡奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，

en.text: Shouldn’tyou also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

zhSimplified.text: 你不应当怜恤你的同伴，像我怜恤你吗？』

zhTraditional.text: 你不應當憐恤你的同伴，像我憐恤你嗎？』

en.text: Hislord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

zhSimplified.text: 主人就大怒，把他交给掌刑的，等他还清了所欠的债。

zhTraditional.text: 主人就大怒，把他交給掌刑的，等他還清了所欠的債。

en.text: Somy heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’ t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们各人若不从心里饶恕你的弟兄，我天父也要这样待你们了。」

zhTraditional.text: 你們各人若不從心裏饒恕你的弟兄，我天父也要這樣待你們了。」
